name: clipboard-diff
title: Clipboard Diff
description: Diff the two most recent Raycast clipboard history entries in VS Code.
author: emilio_micali

commands.name: diff-clipboard
commands.title: Diff Last Two Clipboard Items
commands.subtitle: VS Code
commands.description: Writes the last two clipboard history entries to temp files and opens them with `code --diff`.

preferences.name: editorCommand
preferences.title: Editor CLI
preferences.description: CLI used to open the diff. Must accept `--diff fileA fileB` (code, code-insiders, cursor, windsurf).

preferences.name: fileExtension
preferences.title: Temp File Extension
preferences.description: Extension for the temp files, so the editor picks the right syntax highlighting.
